subject: Add comment and test for bio RDB disk transfer receive timeout (#4277)
reason: The change adds only comments in replication.c (both hunks insert comment lines above pre-existing, unchanged code: the connRecvTimeout call in replicaReceiveRDBFromPrimaryToDisk and the abort-flag/bioDrainWorker logic in cancelReplicationHandshake) plus a TCL integration test documenting the existing repl_syncio_timeout bound on the bio RDB disk-save read. No executable server behaviour changes, so there is nothing new for a scenario to reach.
